product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity and EU pay-transparency compliance software for global enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: The visible navigation and footer list solutions, resources, company information, and demo/contact links, but no pricing page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 122 employees; Tracxn lists 121 as of September 2026, both within this band.

founded_year.notes: Trusaic’s About page says its founder established First Capitol Consulting in 1999 and that the company later evolved into Trusaic.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index has one product-building/“inside the making” AI post, attributed to CEO Robert Sheen; the other listed AI posts are primarily policy or responsible-AI commentary, not two engineering posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public navigation and footer link to the resource center and trust center, but do not link to product documentation, a help center, or a developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings page lists administrative and public-relations roles; a Data Scientist I listing is explicitly marked expired. No currently open AI, ML, or data-science role was found.

model_provider.notes: Trusaic describes its AI as proprietary and in development, says it will not share data with public LLMs, and names Microsoft Azure only as a cloud subprocessor; it does not publicly identify an AI model or model provider.

last_funding.notes: The founder said Trusaic had not taken outside funding; Tracxn reports no funding rounds and Dealroom says there is no known external funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The founder’s statement and funding profiles show no outside round, so none is reported in the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Sales Development Representative posting was listed online November 1, 2026 and includes an Apply now link.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 20, 2026, Trusaic announced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive Monitor with a real-time interactive map.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full leadership page shows no C-level or VP appointment within the window; the only explicit EVP appointment found was Gail Greenfield in 2023. The 2026 appointment announced for Aisling Quirke is as an adviser, not a C-level or VP role; no qualifying departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Trusaic’s public Schedule Demo links route through meetings.hubspot.com.
